preparations.title: Mushroom and herb frittata
preparations.method: Soften the onion and mushrooms in olive oil, then add the spinach to wilt. Beat the eggs with milk, pour into a lined baking dish, scatter over the vegetables and bake until set. Serve with toasted bread.

preparations.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
preparations.method: Roast the chicken thighs with carrots, courgettes, peppers, onions and garlic until browned and cooked through. Cook the rice separately and fluff it. Mix lemon juice with paprika and a little oil, then toss through the vegetables and chicken before boxing.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve 220 g cooked chicken, 220 g cooked rice, and 180 g vegetables at lunch and dinner; at breakfast serve 2 eggs, 120 g sautéed mushrooms, and 2 slices toast.

preparation_shares.note: Take one larger box at lunch and dinner, with extra chicken and rice plus the same vegetable mix.
Take a standard breakfast portion from the fresh batch.
